headline: Fire commission hears evacuation software plans and budget process briefing

meeting.body: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission
meeting.summary: The commission heard about new evacuation software, approved its minutes, heard housing safety concerns, and learned how the fire budget works.
meeting.recap: The vice chair led the meeting because the chair was excused.[[0:00:35]] The commission welcomed a new commissioner.[[0:01:56]] The emergency management administrator said the agency filled one new position, a Hāna staff specialist.[[0:04:17]] The administrator said the final after-action report (a review of an emergency response) will be done December 2, 2024.[[0:06:52]] The administrator said the agency bought two evacuation software tools.[[0:07:09]] The administrator said the software should be running by January 1, 2025.[[0:13:40]] One person testified to welcome the new Hāna staff specialist.[[0:21:09]] The commission approved the minutes of its last meeting by roll call.[[0:22:35]] The fire chief said many housing ideas add density to crowded neighborhoods with substandard roads.[[0:30:38]] The fire chief said housing must be safe so people can get out in an evacuation.[[0:30:49]] The fire chief said the State Fire Council approved a job description for a State Fire Marshal.[[0:35:07]] Ocean safety reported 20 ocean rescues in September.[[1:02:54]] Ocean safety officers responded to three drownings at unguarded beaches.[[1:03:19]] A fire department chief explained how the budget works, ahead of the proposed budget at the next meeting.[[1:11:30]] No executive session (a closed-door meeting) was needed.[[1:37:30]] The next meeting is November 21 at 10 a.m.[[1:38:39]]
decided: A motion to adjourn was made and seconded, and the vice chair declared the meeting adjourned.
meeting.next: The administrator said the partner list for the evacuation software will go out this week, followed by training, an implementation plan and a public education plan. The administrator said commissioners will be invited to shadow the incident management team. The fire department plans to present its proposed budget at the next commission meeting.

moments.q: Roll call vote on the minutes
